# source: installed datetime.sty 2.60 command definitions. \newdate names a
# date, \displaydate and \formatdate set one in the format in force (\longdate
# by default, the day of the week first unless \showdowfalse), the format
# switches choose it and the name commands set one name; \today and a month
# left to the clock read no date, and the time and custom-format commands are
# not modelled.
body impl \newdate{zzd}{15}{1}{2026}\displaydate{zzd}
body impl \formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \dayofweekname{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \shortdayofweekname{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \monthname[3]
body impl \shortmonthname[3]
body impl \newdate{zzd}{15}{1}{2026}\getdateday{zzd}
body impl \newdate{zzd}{15}{1}{2026}\getdatemonth{zzd}
body impl \newdate{zzd}{15}{1}{2026}\getdateyear{zzd}
body impl \longdate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \shortdate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \usdate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \yyyymmdddate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \ddmmyyyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \dmyyyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \ddmmyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \dmyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \mmddyyyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \mdyyyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \mmddyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \mdyydate\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \showdowfalse\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body impl \showdowtrue\formatdate{15}{1}{2026}
body refuse:W0104 \monthname
body refuse:W0104 \today
body refuse:W0301 \textdate
body refuse:W0301 \currenttime
body refuse:W0301 \settimeformat{xxivtime}
body refuse:W0301 \newdateformat{zzf}{\THEDAY}
body impl \ordinaldate{3}
body refuse:W0301 \dateseparator
